name: empirica
description: Empirical-convergence workflow — adjudicates a claim graph (GSN argument with in-toto evidence) where every claim's confidence must be earned by real external evidence: research citations first, deterministic spike verdicts for machine-checkable claims, then an independent auditor on a different model before a run may report convergence. Records which model actually answered each claim, and reports when audit independence was not obtained. Hook-enforced.
